source_scope.lane: model-capacity lineage, latency/interference benchmarks and self-generated feedback contamination

crossread_dedup.peer_overlap: The existing ablation mapping already credits the historical prompt battery/benchmark scaffold, so this shard awards no additional hours for the benchmark itself.
crossread_dedup.unique_delta: Latency/interference constraints, model-capacity lineage and self-generated-training contamination are retained as separate test constraints.

findings.claim: The February 2026 BENCHMARK compared Frank and bare Llama 3.1 8B on the same weights/hardware and reported Frank 61.0% vs bare 51.9%, but the rubric included architecture-specific specificity bonuses and generic-response penalties. It is useful as a probe battery, not clean causal evidence for a global architecture effect.
findings.next_test: Re-run matched factorial ablations with blinded scoring, equal prompts/context budgets and no architecture-name bonus.

findings.claim: The same benchmark documents a large reasoning penalty caused by Core/router/workspace overhead: multiple Frank reasoning probes timed out while the bare model answered in roughly 20-25 seconds despite identical 8B weights.
findings.implication: Cognitive functionality that starves interactive inference is a system failure even if the base model can solve the task. H1/H2/H3 need latency distributions and foreground-vs-background interference tests.

findings.claim: A March 2026 README revision reported 3B vs prior 8B conversational stress-test totals of 59% vs 93%, with the largest gaps in recall (9% vs 76%) and reasoning (0% vs 90%) while identity/opinions remained 100% on both. This is strong evidence that model capacity and architecture contribution must be separated, but it is not a clean same-version controlled experiment.
findings.next_test: Run the same frozen architecture/harness with 4B and larger comparison models under matched quantization/context/LoRA conditions.

findings.claim: Frozen-head README identifies Qwen 3.5-4B as the current single model and explicitly warns that the custom LoRA is not included; the SOMA migration commit changed Qwen2.5-3B to Qwen3.5-4B and records slower fallback generation (~9 tok/s vs ~25 tok/s) plus higher RAM requirements.
findings.implication: Historical benchmark numbers are version-bound. Acceptance receipts must bind exact model, quantization, adapter, hardware and runtime hashes.

findings.claim: A documented degeneration loop allowed room-description text to contaminate idle thoughts, persist into databases, be re-injected into later context and then train the ThoughtSeedVAE, producing a self-reinforcing quality collapse. The fix required removing the source context, filtering stored/reinjected content and retraining the learned component.
findings.implication: Self-generated data needs ancestry labels, contamination controls and trainability policy. Retrieval presence must not imply eligibility for future training.

findings.claim: The 4B migration patch adds history sanitization because specific safety-refusal text in assistant history could prime unrelated future refusals through recency bias. This is another case where generated output becomes a causal future-state input.
findings.implication: History/re-entry must be typed by provenance and causal role; raw assistant output should not automatically become trusted future control context.

earned_work_mapping_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Historical self-generated-data/context contamination failures provide concrete ancestry and trainability-policy tests for retrieval, re-entry and final training-data construction.
earned_work_mapping_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: Training-data and re-entry harness must prove source/ancestry filtering, non-trainable generated-content classes and contamination-resistant replay under recursive self-generation.

branch_feedback.harness: Make foreground latency, background interference, exact model identity and recursive generated-data contamination first-class acceptance tests.
branch_feedback.frank: Do not attribute model-capacity failures to architecture or vice versa; bind every benchmark to model/adapter/runtime identity.
branch_feedback.claycode: Represent scheduling/resource budgets and source/trainability provenance explicitly enough that background cognition cannot silently starve foreground tasks or poison training corpora.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Track generated-vs-observed ancestry and whether an item is eligible for retrieval, re-entry or training as separate semantics.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: One logical substrate must not collapse provenance classes; transcript, generated thought, observation, fact and trainable example require distinct policy states.
branch_feedback.clay: Preserve continuous cognition only under measurable latency/resource budgets; recursive self-generated data is a known Goodhart/degeneration channel.

progress_accounting.reason: Only the unique feedback-contamination failure family is proposed for additional earned-work mapping; strict denominator remains unfrozen.
